response.summary: Overall quality is below the bar despite the notebook running end-to-end and producing outputs. The most important issue is a serious evaluation flaw: the data scaling is fitted on the full dataset before the train/test split, which leaks test information into training and makes the reported performance unreliable. There are also critical reporting inaccuracies: the written conclusion claims 0.97 AUC (and 0.91 precision on “fiber customers”), but the executed test AUC is 0.729 and no precision or fiber-segment analysis is shown. In the interview, ask the candidate to explain why preprocessing must be fit on the training set only (and how to implement it correctly, e.g., with a pipeline), and to walk through how they would verify and report metrics so conclusions match computed results.
